title: Compact settled runtime-observation history and reduce whole-session durability readback cost
outcome: Bound the cost of settled unadmitted-report history in long-lived sessions while preserving pending immutable requests, idempotent accounting and useful settled diagnostics.
acceptance: Only settled report/job data is compacted under a documented retention policy; pending or uncertain immutable requests and keys remain replayable, and tests cover both.
Durability readback avoids repeated parsing/scanning of unrelated session history or has a measured bounded cost; the exact-row-before-send guarantee remains intact.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
